title: "squirrels"
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(cowsay)
set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
coin_toss <- sample(c("Heads", "Tails"), size = 1)
print(coin_toss)
```

```{r}
for (i in seq_len(5))
{coin_toss <- sample(c("Heads", "Tails"), size = 1)
print(coin_toss)}
```

```{r}
coin_tosses <- sample(c("Heads", "Tails"), size = 5, replace = TRUE)
print(coin_tosses)
```

```{r}
n_successes <- sum(coin_tosses == "Heads")
print(n_successes)
```

```{r}
coin_tosses <- sample(c("Heads", "Tails"), size = 5, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.7, 0.3))
print(coin_tosses)
```

```{r}
bm_vec <- c("Badger", "Mushroom", "Snake")
bm_probs <- c(0.95, 0.04, 0.01)

my_sample <- sample(bm_vec, size = 100, replace = TRUE, prob = bm_probs)
print(my_sample)
```

```{r}
is_success <- sample(c("SUCCESS", "FAILURE"),
                     size = 150,
                     replace = TRUE,
                     prob = c(0.3, 0.7)
)
n_successes <- sum(is_success == "SUCCESS")

say(paste("I was successful", n_successes, "times!"), by = "squirrel")
```

```{r}
combined_successes <- c()
for (i in seq_len(1000)) {
  is_success <- sample(c("SUCCESS", "FAILURE"),
                       size = 150,
                       replace = TRUE,
                       prob = c(0.3, 0.7)
  )
  n_successes <- sum(is_success == "SUCCESS")
  combined_successes <- c(combined_successes, n_successes)
}
print(combined_successes)
```

```{r}
df_squirrels <- tibble("N_Successful_Heists" = combined_successes)
gt(head(df_squirrels))
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  df_squirrels,
  aes(
    x = N_Successful_Heists
  )
) +
  geom_bar() +
  ggtitle("Number of Successful Heists per Squirrel - Simulated") +
  xlab("Number of successful heists") +
  ylab("Number of squirrels") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
n <- 150
k <- 48
p <- 0.3

prob_X_equals_k <- dbinom(k, n, p)
print(prob_X_equals_k)
```

```{r}
n_successes <- pull(df_squirrels, N_Successful_Heists)
n_48 <- sum(n_successes == 48)
print(n_48)

print(n_48/1000)
```

```{r}
count_squirrels <- rbinom(n = 1000, size = 150, prob = 0.3)
print(count_squirrels)
```

```{r}
rb_df <- tibble(N_Successful_Heists = count_squirrels)

ggplot(rb_df,
       aes(x = N_Successful_Heists)) +
  geom_bar() +
  ggtitle("Number of Successful Heists per Squirrel - Simulated") +
  xlab("Number of successful heists") +
  ylab("Number of squirrels") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
prob_up_to_48 <- pbinom(48, 150, 0.3)
print(prob_up_to_48)

print(sum(count_squirrels <= 48) / length(count_squirrels))
```

```{r}
n_sims <- 1000
n_flowers_per_sim <- 200

# Simulate 1000 datasets of 200 flowers with
# a 60% chance of being pollinated
flowers <- rbinom(
  n = n_sims,
  size = n_flowers_per_sim,
  prob = 0.6
)

# How many times were at least 125 flowers
# pollinated?
times_successful <- sum(flowers >= 125)

# What proportion of the attempts is this?
prop_successful <- times_successful / n_sims
print(prop_successful)
```

```{r}
# Probability that less than 125 flowers are
# pollinated
prob_under_125 <- pbinom(124, 200, 0.6)

# Probability that at least 125 flowers are
# pollinated
prob_125_or_over <- 1 - prob_under_125

print(prob_125_or_over)
```
